availability_wall.rule: for observation month M, query ALFRED with vintage_date equal to the 25th of month M+1; derived features become usable on that vintage date and later
availability_wall.reason: conservative publication wall after the normal G.17 mid-month release; avoids requiring a release-calendar parser in the first consumer

rebase_policy.IPG3344S: never concatenate raw index levels across first-print vintages because ALFRED documents historical index-base changes; compute percentage changes inside each single vintage snapshot
rebase_policy.CAPUTLHITEK2S: capacity-utilization percent level is retained, with changes computed inside the same vintage snapshot

per_month_snapshot: each ALFRED request must include at least the current observation and prior 12 monthly observations as they existed at that same vintage; no values from a later vintage may fill an earlier cache row
missing_policy: fail closed for a monthly cache row when any predeclared feature cannot be derived from that vintage; do not current-history backfill
next_boundary: a source PASS permits one cache-build run; only after that exact cache is retained and hashed may the separately frozen equity path-head consumer run
